request_sent_by_web.assessmentId: string | null (latest completed assessment, so answers can use its results)

questions_for_ai_team: Do you need the full answers/scores sent with each message, or will you look them up by assessmentId?
Will replies stream? (The web currently expects one JSON response.)
Expected response time? The web side times out after 60 seconds.
notes: Send back the URL (goes in .env as AI_CHAT_URL) and API key if any (AI_API_KEY). The web limits each user to 20 messages per minute.
